task: Fix Refresh button alignment regression in IntegrationSection caused by EPMCDME-10302 layout refactor, ensuring the button aligns correctly with IntegrationSelectDropdown across both render paths.

key_reasoning.reason: Root cause is well-identified (CSS specificity race between h-7 from ButtonSize.MEDIUM and !h-8 override, plus IntegrationSelectDropdown variable-height render paths), but the fix approach has two valid options: fix the !h-8 specificity or restructure the flex container for consistent alignment. One lightweight decision needed before coding.

The !h-8 Tailwind important override is the only such pattern in the codebase and is documented as fragile (once already required a size change from SMALL to MEDIUM). The two render paths in IntegrationSelectDropdown (label+dropdown vs button-only) mean the chosen fix must handle both without introducing a new visual inconsistency. Change is purely CSS/layout and trivially reversible.
